verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Windows has a Microsoft Store submission pipeline for apps, implying an app store exists for installing apps, but there's no evidence describing the consumer one-click install experience, curated popular-app catalog, or switcher-focused onboarding. missing for 10: evidence of the Store's consumer install UX, catalog breadth/popularity of apps, one-click install flow, and independent corroboration of ease-of-use for switchers.
